name: Bronzed Cutworm
desc: Bronzed Cutworm (Nephelodes minians): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 4 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Nephelodes minians, the bronzed cutworm or shaded umber moth, is a moth of the family Noctuidae. It is found in most of North America, except Florida and adjacent states.
